category_title: Child with ASD, ADHD, and Specific Learning Disability exhibiting significant behavioral resistance to reading instruction
scenario_title: Initial letter sound instruction and memory retrieval
minimal_context: Sam and his tutor are working one-on-one in a quiet spot to practice remembering the sounds of previously taught letters when a new letter is introduced.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We have a new letter today. But first, let's look at the letter we learned yesterday. What sound does this one make?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks away) I don't want to read.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look at the letter. What sound is it?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't remember! I'm not doing it!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to remember. We need to finish this instructional task.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No! (Gets out of his chair and begins roaming the classroom, screaming and starting to have a meltdown)
